cost: Gross_bps = weighted sum of both signed simple leg returns. Cost1x = sum(weight_leg * that symbol verified round-trip bps); cost2x doubles both leg costs only. Each economic row must retain both entry/exit prices, weights and cost source identity. Funding is separate and cannot be guessed.
entry: One frozen BTC/ETH pair. At completed 30m close, same-sign residual zscore remains at least 2 standard deviations from frozen mean and contracts versus previous completed close. One trade per same-sign excursion; rearm only after frozen-mean crossing. Enter both legs next 30m open, never signal close.
exit: First completed close reaching/crossing frozen mean, or re-expanding to/beyond entry absolute z, or 8 held 30m bars. Execute both legs next 30m open. Expire at next formation boundary without re-fitting an open trade. Never bridge a source gap; a missing next execution bar is unresolved, not a synthetic fill.
formation: Previous complete UTC Monday-to-Monday 7-day block (336 exact 30m closes); OLS log(BTC)=intercept+beta*log(ETH); freeze beta/intercept/residual sample standard deviation for next UTC week. Positive beta and finite nonzero residual variance required. AR(1) residual phi must be strictly between 0 and 1, a structural mean-reversion condition, no fitted profitability threshold.
formation_is_fit_only: Uses no trade outcomes or trading-window candles. All training closes must be available by trading-window start. Missing bar/segment change invalidates whole formation.
pair_selection: BTC-USDT / ETH-USDT fixed a priori; no symbol or correlation optimization
parameter_reason: 7-day UTC calendar blocks include each day of week and separate formation from trading. 2 residual standard deviations is a preregistered stretch mechanism, not a grade threshold. 8-bar maximum retains parent intraday horizon. One configuration only; no grid.
weights: Positive-beta hedge gross notional fixed to 1.0 total: BTC 1/(1+beta), ETH beta/(1+beta); fixed units at entry, no rebalancing. Positive z: short BTC, long ETH; negative z: long BTC, short ETH.
